title: Recording: Lady Gaye by Ringo Starr | 1976
content:
Cherokee Studios, Los Angeles
Producer: Arif Mardin

Ringo Starr began recording his fifth studio album, Ringo’s Rotogravure, on 22 May 1976.

The first song to be recorded was ‘Lady Gaye’. It was based on Clifford T Ward’s ‘Birmingham’, which appeared on his 1975 album No More Rock ‘N’ Roll. Ward was credited as a co-writer, along with Starr and Vini Poncia.

‘Lady Gaye’ was completed with additional overdubs in August and September 1976.
